title: Verdict — deepened render_verdict (summary + converged + result + winner + reasoning, argumentation-based, no fact-checking) wired into the engine (Epic 8, issue #62)
prompt:
Implement render_verdict: the controller writes a summary of the debate, whether the agents converged/agreed, the result, and WHO WON with reasoning — judged on argumentation/rebuttal/engagement, NOT factual correctness (no fact-checking).

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: usage to be filled by main loop from harness report

note: Deepens the 4.4 BASELINE render_verdict into the PRD §3.2 step-4 verdict and wires it into run_debate_loop. TDD red-first: wrote packages/core/tests/test_verdict.py (8 tests), watched 6 fail, implemented to green. Verdict model (skills/models.py) gained ADDITIVE fields summary:str='', converged:bool=False, criteria_scores:dict[DebateSide,dict[str,float]]={} (back-compat defaults so the 4.4 contract + DebateResult tests stay green). NEW skills/_verdict_logic.py: score_debate(turns) scores each side on three NAMED criteria from transparent text signals — argumentation = sum(base weight + controller-supplied per-turn score), rebuttal = count of NAMED rebuttal markers x weight, engagement = count of NAMED engagement markers x weight; winner = higher aggregate total, TIE within VERDICT_TIE_MARGIN; converged = both sides carry agreement/concession markers. build_verdict(request) assembles the full Verdict (winner resolved verbatim from a controller-supplied winner else derived; rationale verbatim else reasoning template; summary = result + convergence note + 'judged on argumentation/rebuttal/engagement — not factual correctness'). NO fact-checking anywhere — a test proves a factually-false but better-argued side wins. NEW skills/_verdict_constants.py holds ALL marker phrase sets / criterion weights / tie margin / convergence threshold / criteria labels / summary+reasoning templates (split out of constants.py to keep it <150 lines). controller.py render_verdict now delegates to build_verdict (still pure/deterministic, no LLM/network, gatekeeper N/A) and stays <150 lines. Engine wiring: loop.py new _verdict(messages, run_id, runs_dir, sink) builds TranscriptTurns from the main+closing transcript (failed markers excluded; all-failed -> None), calls render_verdict, sets DebateResult.verdict, and logs+streams a 'verdict' event via emit_event (6.6) under the neutral LOOP_VERDICT_LOG_AGENT='controller' with LOOP_VERDICT_EVENT_TYPE='verdict' (constants added to constants.py). Updated the honest existing test test_render_verdict_does_not_leak_controller_stance to expect the additive fields (still asserts no stance/opinion). Gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . clean; mypy = no issues in 162 source files; pytest --cov = 615 passed, 99.95% total coverage (_verdict_logic.py / _verdict_constants.py / controller.py / loop.py at 100%; >=85 required); check_line_limit.py rc=0; secret_scan.py rc=0. Files: NEW skills/_verdict_logic.py, NEW skills/_verdict_constants.py, NEW tests/test_verdict.py; EDIT skills/models.py (Verdict additive fields), skills/controller.py (render_verdict delegates to build_verdict + imports/docstring), constants.py (LOOP_VERDICT_* event constants), engine/loop.py (_verdict helper + wiring + imports/docstrings), tests/test_controller_skills.py (honest dump-keys update), docs/PROMPTS.md (8.3 entry).
